snippet.title: Black Jacket - Cinematic Trailer - FGS Live From LA 2026
snippet.description:
A Cinematic Trailer for Black Jacket. Gamble your way out of hell in this blackjack-inspired rogue-lite deckbuilder. Play powerful card combos or cheat to outwit your opponents and earn your freedom. Win their Soul coins! Bribe the ferryman! And uncover the story of those who stand in your way. 

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS
